title: Dan Quinn says he talked to Jayden Daniels about ill-advised fourth-down throwaway vs. 49ers, wants QB to take his 'shot'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dan Quinn says he talked to Jayden Daniels about ill-advised fourth-down throwaway vs. 49ers, wants QB to take his 'shot'
sources.description: Daniels tossed the ball out of bounds on a fourth-and-2 from the San Francisco 13-yard line, turning the ball over on downs early in the second quarter of a "Monday Night Football" loss.
